integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 3D CG animated commercial, bright bouncy cartoon style with hyper-saturated color — vivid orange-yellow, clean white, fresh green, deep cookie black, and brilliant sky blue. A flat, brilliant sky-blue background fills the frame as a glossy 3D cartoon hand darts in quickly from the left and snatches a sandwich cookie floating at center. The cookie whips into a rapid spin, then snaps apart vertically, revealing a glowing, vivid orange fruit filling, and the camera plunges straight into the filling's core. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to the interior: the camera rockets at high speed through a spiraling tunnel of swirling, glossy golden jam, entering with a sharp "Whoosh" sound effect. [Shot 3] At 00:05.000, the tunnel bursts open into a wildly chaotic citrus fantasy playground. The camera skims at high speed along a bright yellow curved slide; sandwich cookies, white cream swirls, and lemon-orange drink cups whip past on both sides while small green cartoon characters sprint and tumble everywhere. Cream hills rise in the background as launcher devices fire round cookies into the air in exaggerated looping arcs, and the ground is carpeted with citrus crumbs — festive, hot, and joyfully out of control. [Shot 4] At 00:09.000, the camera brakes hard and pushes in fast for a close-up hero shot of a single sandwich cookie, then immediately plunges into a second tunnel — a golden double helix — twisting through it at high rotational speed. [Shot 5] At 00:11.000, the camera blasts out of the tunnel mouth and shoots straight through the dark central hole of a giant sandwich cookie; the frame snaps hard to a clean sky-blue background. [Shot 6] At 00:12.500, the shot cuts to a hyper-realistic sandwich cookie floating at center against the blue, slowly and subtly rotating as its surface embossing and texture catch the light. White handwritten-style 3D letters spelling "RELLENA de SORPRESAS" pop up one by one from below, arranging into a semicircle, each letter landing with a crisp "Ping" sound effect, as the music surges to its peak and cuts off cleanly on the final letter.

overall_soundscape: Dense, tightly synced cartoon sound effects drive the whole spot — a quick snatch, a fast cookie spin and vertical snap, a sharp "Whoosh" on tunnel entry, high-speed whooshing air along the slide, launcher thumps and bouncing cookie impacts, a hard brake, a second rushing tunnel fly-through, a blast through the giant cookie's hole, and a crisp "Ping" for each letter as it pops into place.

non_diegetic_music: High-tempo pop electronic track with no vocals, dense and driving drum rhythms, punchy synth stabs landing on every cut, building relentlessly, surging to its peak under the final letters, then ending crisply on the last "Ping."
